channel.title: Brenner - web
channel.description: Opinionated, modern, pretty, and clean Zola theme.

item.title: thinking about semantic html
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I spent a while getting semantic html wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Semantic html shows up across web work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
